newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay sugar hit by poor consumer buying, volumes.
newsitem.headline: Bombay sugar hit by poor consumer buying, volumes.

text.p: Bombay sugar prices on Wednesday held steady on low consumer buying and volumes due to the absence of some traders as heavy rain lashed parts of the city, dealers said.
The local sugar market had a delayed start as early session trade was halted due to the death of a leading sugar dealer.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 was steady at 1,455/1,480 rupees per quintal and sugar M-30 at 1,485/1,528 rupees per quintal. Arrivals of sugar from mills to the market also remained low as rain has disrupted transportation of sugar.
Sugar mill delivery too remained quiet amid limited offerings by the millers as well as slow outstation buying at the mill delivery.
In the mill delivery, sugar S-30 was steady at 1,390/1,405 rupees per quintal so was M-30 at 1,410/1,425 rupees per quintal.
